Are these pouches BPA free?
Yes. We use food-grade materials and spouts that are BPA free and compliant with FDA/EU regulations.

Custom Spout Pouches — Engineering Summary

  • Custom Spout Pouches is quoted as a B2B project with MOQ 500 PCS.
  • Primary specification cluster: Liquid & Puree Flexible Packaging.
  • Buyer should provide filling volume, product acidity/viscosity, and filling temperature.
  • Engineering confirmation includes spout diameter (8.5mm, 10mm, 15mm), material structure, and leak testing.
  • BestPackFactory supports OEM / ODM size, logo, finish, and tamper-evident caps.
Technical Specification

Custom Spout Pouches Technical Specification

The table below is written for industrial RFQ comparison. Final production specification is confirmed by sample approval and filling test.

Recommended material structurePET 12µm / NY 15µm / PE 80-120µm; PET 12µm / AL 7µm / NY 15µm / PE 80µm
Spout Diameter8.5mm, 10mm, 15mm, 22mm; center or corner position options
Barrier targetOTR ≤ 1.5 cc/m²·day; WVTR ≤ 1.5 g/m²·day for sauce packaging
Seal strength≥ 40 N / 15 mm for liquid-tight security
Typical capacity50ml, 100ml, 250ml, 500ml, 1L, 2L; custom volume available
Surface finishGlossy, Matte, Soft-touch, Spot UV, hot foil optional
Printing registration tolerance±0.3 mm for multi-color gravure printing
Recommended testVacuum leak test + spout pull test + filled drop test at 1.0 m
MOQ500 PCS per custom size / artwork
Artwork fileAI / PDF / PSD accepted; vector logo required; 3 mm bleed
Color toleranceΔE ≤ 3.0 against approved digital proof
Dimension tolerance±2 mm for pouch size; ±1 mm for spout position
Quality inspectionAQL 2.5 for major defects; 100% leak test for spout insertion
RFQ data requiredVolume, filling temperature, product type, artwork, quantity, destination

RFQ Checklist for Factory Quotation

  1. Confirm filling volume (ml) and filling process (cold/hot/pasteurization).
  2. Send AI/PDF artwork with 3 mm bleed and cap color requirement.
  3. Choose material structure (clear/foil/matte) and spout diameter.
  4. Tell us destination country, quantity and delivery method.
